Here's a concise apology email draft:

**Subject:** Apology — [brief context, e.g., "Missed deadline" / "Meeting conflict"]

Hi [Name],

I'm sorry for [specific issue — e.g., "missing yesterday's deadline on the Q3 report" / "not being able to attend today's sync"]. It was [brief reason if appropriate — e.g., "an oversight on my part" / "a scheduling conflict I should have flagged earlier"], and I own that.

I've [corrective action — e.g., "submitted the report this morning" / "reviewed the recording and shared notes with the team"]. Going forward, I'll [prevention — e.g., "set earlier internal checkpoints" / "block calendar time for recurring meetings"].

Thanks for your patience.

Best,  
[Your name]

---

PLAN: Ask user for the specific situation and colleague's name to personalize the draft  
PLAN: Offer 2-3 tone variations (formal, casual, brief) based on their relationship  
PLAN: Suggest adding a brief follow-up action item if relevant
